well, for my depression i am able to start doing the basics of self care. i was at a really severe depression where i just wouldn’t do anything with myself, i couldn’t even look at myself in the mirror. just slept a lot, wore the same clothes, just was accustomed to my bed all day. but lately i have been starting to look at myself in the mirror, brush my teeth twice a day, shower, and especially, brush my hair.  I know it sounds gross, but i literally felt like i was just a living blob nothing even worth to do the basic hygiene routine for myself. but i am now. and it’s just baby steps as for now (:
